title: Gem5-MARVEL: Microarchitecture-Level Resilience Analysis of Heterogeneous SoC Architectures
problem: No unified microarchitecture-level fault injection framework exists for heterogeneous SoCs with multiple ISAs and domain-specific accelerators. Designers lack tools to simultaneously analyze resilience and performance across heterogeneous systems.
motivation: Analyzing hardware fault resilience at the microarchitecture level is critical for designing reliable heterogeneous systems with diverse processor types and accelerators.
method: gem5-MARVEL extends gem5 with a modular fault injection infrastructure supporting flexible fault models and system configurations. It provides automation libraries for fault injection and analysis during full system execution across multiple ISAs (x86, Arm, RISC-V) and diverse accelerator types.
key_novelty: First consolidated microarchitecture-level fault injection framework for heterogeneous SoCs supporting multiple ISAs and domain-specific accelerators.
contributions: Consolidated fault injection infrastructure for heterogeneous SoCs
Support for x86, Arm, and RISC-V ISAs
Automation libraries for fault injection and analysis
